title: Audio serverless worker input (audio-serverless/v1)
description: RunPod serverless input: a prepared ComfyUI API audio graph plus the application parameter snapshot. The worker executes the graph unchanged and never chooses a model.

prompt.description: Prepared ComfyUI API graph (node id -> {class_type, inputs}) built by the application from audio_models.graph.template. The worker submits it unchanged; it never builds, edits or selects a model.

kind.description: Request kind. Duration limits (contract §1.1): sfx/layer <= 30 s, music <= 90 s.

duration_seconds.description: Snapshot of the requested duration; tracing/limit data only. The output duration is measured from the produced file.

seed.description: Snapshot of the seed rendered into the graph; tracing data only. The reported seed is read from the executed sampler node.

prompt_hash.description: Application hash of the prompt/template snapshot; tracing data only.

model_slug.description: Application catalog slug snapshot; tracing data only. The worker does not choose a model: the executed model is whatever the submitted graph loads and is reported from execution.

assets.description: Audio contract has no input assets: the application always sends {} (contract §1.2). No other fields are accepted.

policy.description: Optional RunPod policy (executionTimeout/ttl). The worker does not read it; RunPod applies it before the handler runs.
